_meta.theme: light marketing page on a #111 body; no dark toggle

black.source: Measured: computed color of nav-menu default and background of button-primary default (raw/components-computed.json); stylesheet --black is the keyword black

white.source: Measured: computed color of button-primary default and background of the marketing page (home-dark-default.png region; computed rgb(255,255,255) on button text)

blackish.source: Measured: stylesheet custom property --black-ish on https://www.vsco.co/ (raw/css-vars.json) and computed body backgroundColor rgb(17, 17, 17)

gold.source: Measured: stylesheet --v1-gold and computed backgroundColor of button-gold default rgb(255, 188, 60)

goldHover.source: Measured: computed backgroundColor of button-gold hover, CDP forcePseudoState hover (raw/components-computed.json)

goldOnWhite.source: Measured: stylesheet custom property --gold-on-white (raw/css-vars.json). Not observed as a painted control on the captured pages.

pink.source: Measured: computed backgroundColor of button-banner default rgb(255, 8, 119). Not a custom property.

pinkHover.source: Measured: computed backgroundColor of button-banner hover, CDP forcePseudoState hover

green.source: Measured: stylesheet custom property --surface-green (raw/css-vars.json). Not observed painted on the captured pages.

red.source: Measured: stylesheet custom property --100-red-l (raw/css-vars.json). Not observed painted on the captured pages.

disabled.source: Measured: computed backgroundColor of the disabled CONTINUE button on https://vsco.co/user/login when that URL served the email step (rgb(117, 117, 117))

family.source: Measured: computed fontFamily of nav-menu, hero-heading, and body on https://www.vsco.co/

display.source: Measured: hero-heading computed fontSize 100px, fontWeight 500, height 180px over two lines so line-height 90px

nav.source: Measured: nav-menu default fontSize 15px, fontWeight 500. Line height derived as 1.5 of the size; the element height is 38.5px including 8px padding.

body.source: Measured: menu-link default fontSize 16px, fontWeight 400. Line height not captured as a separate computed lineHeight; 24px is derived as 1.5.

button.source: Measured: button-gold height 40px and disabled CONTINUE height 40px

banner.source: Measured: inline custom property --banner-h 50px on the home page html element

menu.source: Measured: menu-link transitionDuration 0.45s, derived to ms

button.source: Measured: plan-cta transitionDuration 0.85s, derived to ms

page.source: Measured: marketing sections paint white; home screenshot and button text white on black. Body element background is blackish and shows in the dark band.

inverse.source: Measured: body backgroundColor rgb(17, 17, 17) and the home 'Your home for photography' band

surface.source: Measured: products menu panel paints white (home-dark-products-menu.png)

banner.source: Measured: top promo bar shares the banner button pink; the bar fill was not read as its own computed style. The button fill is the evidence.

primary.source: Measured: nav-menu and hero-heading color rgb(0, 0, 0)

onAccent.source: Measured: button-primary and button-banner color rgb(255, 255, 255)

inverse.source: Measured: tab default color rgb(255, 255, 255) on the dark band

muted.source: Measured token --v1-dark-grey. Not confirmed as the computed color of a muted label in this capture.

default.source: Measured: nav-menu borderTopColor rgb(0, 0, 0) at width 0. Outline buttons paint a hairline; that width was not captured on a visible outline button.

disabled.source: Measured: disabled CONTINUE on the login URL email step

ring.source: Measured: nav-menu focus-visible outline 1px auto. Colour of the auto ring was not a custom colour.
